value.name: Service technician
value.description: Dealer / fleet workshop technician who diagnoses and repairs drive units.

value.name: Manufacturing (plant / EOL test)
value.description: Contract plant building 50k units/yr (SMT boards, die-cast housing) and running end-of-line test.

value.name: Regulators / certification bodies
value.description: EU and US authorities and notified bodies for EN 15194, UL 2849, FCC Part 15 / RED, UN 38.3, IEC 62133-2.

value.text: Technicians need to find the cause of a drive-unit fault quickly, because workshop time is billed per job and a bike off the road costs the rider or fleet money.
Technicians and riders need to take the battery off the bike with no special tools, because special tools are often not to hand at the roadside or in small workshops.
The plant needs to build 50,000 units a year, because that is the planned sales volume.
The plant needs each unit checked at end of line quickly, because a long test holds up the line and stops it reaching the planned volume.

Regulators need evidence that the drive unit, its radios and its battery meet the EU and US e-bike, radio, cell-safety and transport rules before it is sold or shipped, because the product cannot legally go on sale without it.

value.name: Mean time to diagnose
value.metric: time from start of diagnosis to fault identified, mean over the fault catalogue

value.name: Special tools needed for battery removal
value.metric: number of special (non-standard) tools needed to remove the battery

value.name: Certifications passed first time
value.metric: share of required certifications (EN 15194, UL 2849, FCC Part 15, RED, UN 38.3, IEC 62133-2) passed at first submission

author: agent:needs
rationale: Adds the PRD stakeholders not covered by staged patch 3fef2fe8fc (rider, fleet): service, manufacturing, regulators. Each gets needs in plain stakeholder language with a reason ('because ...') and one MoE with a number. The needs avoid naming solutions; 'SMT + die-cast' is kept only in the stakeholder description as context. Ids start at N-10 / MOE-10 so they cannot clash with 3fef2fe8fc. MOE-14 target (100% passed at first submission) is PROVISIONAL because the PRD only lists the standards. Regulation elements (REG-) are left to the requirements role.
